subject.title: [Feature]: Add Ralph Loop feature and add max iteration number into the agent configuration

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated Ralph-style repeated-prompt loop default, fold this need into the broader agent iteration-budget contract, or reject repeated-prompt looping as outside core?
rationale: The issue adds new runtime behavior and public config precedence; current main has adjacent safeguards but no accepted STOP-driven repeated-prompt loop contract.

options.title: Fold into iteration budget
options.body: Use one opt-in OpenClaw-native iteration-budget contract that covers per-agent defaults and clearly separates intentional repeated-prompt loops from accidental tool loops.

options.title: Add dedicated Ralph loop
options.body: Add a separate Ralph/repeated-prompt loop surface with explicit STOP, unlimited, interruption, restart, and transcript semantics.

options.title: Reject core loop surface
options.body: Document existing alternatives through runRetries, tool-loop detection, and external plugin/runtime work instead of adding a new core loop mode.

recommendation.title: Fold into iteration budget
recommendation.body: Use one opt-in OpenClaw-native iteration-budget contract that covers per-agent defaults and clearly separates intentional repeated-prompt loops from accidental tool loops.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the clearest combination of prior issue review context and recent adjacent agent-runtime work.
